messages:
tama: Quick announcement: shipped a patch to sdk-runtime (v3.2.5) that sanitizes env-config parsing for boolean-like values. Not a model change but can flip feature flags in some CI.
eli: what was broken before?
tama: previously values like 'false', '0', 'off' were truthy in our YAML/ENV parsing for feature toggles in some edge cases. We've standardized to strict boolean parsing and added a fast-fail on ambiguous values.
sophie: is there a compatibility shim? any docs?
tama: yes 12 docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/980 "Runtime config: strict bool parsing + migration notes". Also added a tiny shim function in the cli: `redwood-cli config normalize-bools` that rewrites ambiguous values.
docs-bot: changelog entry added: "sdk-runtime v3.2.5: strict boolean parsing for env/config, migration helper provided". Risk: low but may affect custom scripts that relied on loose parsing.
infra-bot: Scan result: 14 repos in org flagged ambiguous boolean env-vars (examples: ENABLE_CACHE=0, USE_X=off).
eli: timeline for removal of loose parsing?
tama: we'll keep loose mode behind `REDWOOD_LEGACY_BOOL_PARSING=1` for 60 days. After that we remove legacy mode. Recommend teams run the shim and update CI before 30 days.
sophie: i'll add a short note to the internal migration playbook and ping SRE owners.
tama: thanks 12 if you need extra runway DM me.
